criteria.statement: The wrapper CLI reads one invocation JSON document from stdin, writes one structured outcome JSON document to stdout, returns process code 0 for structured success or structured failure, and rejects malformed or trailing JSON as execution_failed.

Dry-run provision validates required resolved params, creates deterministic workspace/state/audit files, returns running OpenClaw binding state, and exact replay returns the same logical outcome without repeating mutation work.
Provision rejects duplicate local state conflicts, unsafe agent IDs, and inline private secret material before local runtime mutation.

Persona update writes normalized persona data and generated prompt files for an existing non-revoked agent, preserves running runtime binding, and reports a live hot-reload warning when runtime reload is not confirmed.

Revoke records revoked state, honors delete_workspace false and true, preserves audit state, warns when credential revocation is requested but not configured, and non-dry-run replay does not repeat local commands.
The wrapper rejects unsupported methods with unsupported_method instead of silently accepting unimplemented lifecycle semantics.
Non-dry-run provision uses configured containerized OpenClaw commands and does not emit persistent bare-metal gateway or agent process commands.
Local command execution failures return structured failed outcomes and persist failed audit state; exact replay of that failed invocation uses the cached failure rather than re-running the command.

The OpenClaw sidecar invokes the real openclaw-soulfactory-control wrapper through OpenClawCommandDriver in dry-run from a signed kind 38384 runtime-control request, publishes a signed correlated kind 38386 result, replays the cached result without invoking wrapper side effects again, rejects conflicting idempotency-key reuse before wrapper execution including params-only conflicts, and reports idempotency persistence failures as failed 38386 results.
